else on the site, delete the checklist and describe the change instead.
-->

## Adding a project

Project file: `content/projects/________.md`

- [ ] The repository is public on GitHub.
- [ ] The repository has a README explaining what the project does and how to use it.
- [ ] The repository has a license.
- [ ] It contains no identifiable information about people and no data my institution restricts.
- [ ] I removed `draft: true` (or set it to `false`) so the listing will appear.
- [ ] I'm a maintainer of the project, or I have the maintainers' agreement to list it.

The **Build site** check below confirms the file is filled in correctly and that the
repository can be found. If it fails, open its details to see which field to fix.
